##### Project general facts

District One West is a prestigious gated residential community in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, offering an exclusive collection of 4-, 5-, and 6-bedroom villas surrounded by lush green landscapes and the spectacular Crystal Lagoon. Designed around a refined and sophisticated lifestyle, the development combines contemporary architecture, generous outdoor spaces, and world-class amenities to create an exceptional residential environment. Each villa is thoughtfully designed to balance privacy, comfort, and a strong connection with nature.

The villas showcase distinctive contemporary architecture with clean lines, geometric forms, expansive glazing, and natural stone details. The 6-bedroom villas feature three levels with spacious outdoor terraces and large glass façades, while the 5-bedroom villas combine minimalist stone and glass exteriors with shaded balconies and landscaped outdoor living areas. The 4-bedroom villas are defined by projecting upper floors, large windows, white plaster, and natural stone textures, creating a bold yet elegant appearance.

The interiors are designed around modern minimalist living, with spacious layouts and abundant glazing that brings natural light into every level and creates a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. High-quality exterior finishes and carefully selected materials enhance the sophisticated character of the villas, while generous terraces provide additional spaces for relaxation and entertaining. The kitchens are equipped, while the villas are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Quoz 2 is a centrally located residential district in Dubai, situated between Al Khail Road and Meydan Road. The area forms part of the wider Hadaeq Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid district, a prestigious master-planned community known for its upscale residential developments, landscaped surroundings, and growing collection of lifestyle destinations. The location offers convenient access to major roads, making it easy to reach different parts of Dubai.

The neighbourhood combines a peaceful residential atmosphere with convenient urban infrastructure. Al Quoz 2 features villas, residential properties, local amenities, and green spaces, while nearby Al Quoz Pond Park provides a family-friendly outdoor destination with a pond, jogging tracks, and picnic areas. The surrounding Hadaeq Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid community further enhances the area with landscaped parks, water features, and pedestrian-friendly spaces.

Thanks to its central position and strong road connectivity, residents have convenient access to key destinations across Dubai. Al Quoz 2 is close to Dubai Hills, Meydan, Downtown Dubai, and other established communities, while Al Khail Road provides direct connections to major business, retail, and leisure hubs. The combination of accessibility, greenery, and a growing residential environment makes the area an attractive choice for modern family living.
